PROP-57888860-inv-001.text: Fiat-Shamir challenge hash must include all verifier-relevant inputs to prevent selective forgery.
PROP-57888860-inv-001.assertion: forall batch_verify(comms, cells, proofs, idx): hash_input contains DOMAIN || BLOB_SIZE || CELL_SIZE || len(comms) || len(idx) || comms || idx || evals || proofs
